player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" while in the Exercise room, which still had an untried direction (east) available. My mistake was failing to exhaust all available directions in a room before declaring the exploration complete. Next time, I will strictly follow a rule: only issue "DONE" when the list of currently available directions is empty or when I have explicitly visited every reachable room and confirmed no new paths exist. Specifically, upon returning to the Exercise room with available directions [west, east], I must choose the unvisited direction (east) instead of stopping, ensuring I explore the full map before terminating.
